Frequently Asked Questions

Video conferencing or web conferencing, video calls, or online video meetings enable teams worldwide to quickly meet face-to-face with just an internet connection.

Get the enterprise-grade functionality you’re looking for on your next video conference call. RingCentral's free video conferencing tool lets you place an unlimited number of video meetings on our industry-leading video conferencing software.

You can even download our easy-to-use app and take your video meeting on your Android and iOS devices. Or take your meeting from a no-download link and join from your favorite web browser, such as Google Chrome.

There are no limits to the number of video meetings you can host, even on RingCentral’s free conference solution.

Host all the virtual meetings that you want and have full confidence in hosting both 1:1s or group video calls 24 hours a day, 7 days a week (on a paid plan).

With RingCentral video meetings, you can host or join your online meeting from anywhere.

Whether you’re on the go, on a commute to work, or working from home, you can easily start from a mobile device and switch to your laptop with a click of a button.

You can even download our easy-to-use app and take your video meeting on your Android and iOS devices. Or take your meeting from a no-download link and join from your favorite web browser, such as Google Chrome.

RingCentral’s video conferencing solution is absolutely secure and trusted by big and small businesses worldwide. 

Our virtual meetings come with multi-layer security and are GDPR, HIPAA, and HITRUST certified. Your free plan includes features such as a waiting room and user authentication to make sure only authorized users can join your meetings.

Add an extra layer of confidentiality in your meetings. RingCentral’s video conferencing solution (yes, even the free version) also comes with dynamic end-to-end encryption (E2EE), allowing you to turn it on in the middle of the meeting for more confidential conversations.

Whether working remotely or hybrid, team collaboration allows your team members to work asynchronously. Reduce email clutter and simplify your workflows with dedicated folders, teams and tasks for projects and topics. Send files, pin documents, and connect to other apps you're already using.

Easily use our Team Connect feature to bring together team members from a video call into a working team. You can even set up a virtual meeting room where your team members can come in and out of anytime with Team Huddle.

Of course! RingCentral’s video conferencing system allows for you to easily screen share content. In addition, users are able to annotate, mark-up, or even draw on a virtual whiteboard canvas for real-time collaboration.

On a mobile device, you can also share the virtual whiteboard. In addition, you have the option to share content directly from Google Drive or from your back camera to show real-life content as it happens.

RingCentral’s video conferencing app comes with a wealth of features that allow for smooth, interactive conversations. Some basic features include HD audio and video quality, calendar integrations with Microsoft Outlook and Google Calendar, virtual backgrounds, waiting rooms, and personalized meeting links. More advanced features include AI-enabled live transcription and advanced meeting insights, whiteboard, breakout rooms, and dynamic end-to-end encryption.

These video meeting features are available no matter where you join, whether through desktop apps, mobile apps (Android or iOS), or a supported web browser.

In a world of remote work and globally distributed teams, it’s more important than ever to ensure that everyone stays connected. With RingCentral’s best video conferencing app, you can invite anyone to your online video meetings. Invite your co-workers or guests by sending them your personal meeting link.

You can also ensure that you don’t get unauthorized entry into your meeting by turning on the waiting room, enforcing user authentication, or password protecting your meeting.

No download is required to join a RingCentral video meeting, even with our free plan. Instead of downloading the RingCentral app, simply join from a supported web browser.

Desktop: Microsoft Edge, Google Chrome, Firefox, Safari

Mobile: Google Chrome (Android), Safari (iOS)

With our free plan, you can run unlimited 50 minute meetings. And yes, you’re free to schedule as many meetings as you’d like. 

With a paid plan, you’ll have full confidence in hosting a 1:1 call or video meeting with more than 2 attendees by hosting a meeting 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
